name: figma-mcp-rs
description: Figma + FigJam MCP server with full read/write access via a plugin bridge. No API token, no REST rate limits. 78 tools and 12 prompts, written in Rust. Port of vkhanhqui/figma-mcp-go.

tools.name: add_page
tools.description: Add a new page to the Figma document

tools.name: add_variable_mode
tools.description: Add a new mode to an existing variable collection (e.g. Light/Dark, Desktop/Mobile). Figma free plan allows only 1 mode per collection

tools.name: apply_style_to_node
tools.description: Apply an existing local style (paint, text, effect, or grid) to a node, linking the node to that style

tools.name: batch_rename_nodes
tools.description: Rename multiple nodes using find/replace, regex substitution, or prefix/suffix addition

tools.name: bind_variable_to_node
tools.description: Bind a local variable to a node property so the property is driven by the variable's value; omit variableId to unbind

tools.name: bind_variable_to_style
tools.description: Bind a variable to a local style so the style itself is driven by a design token

tools.name: clone_node
tools.description: Clone an existing node, optionally repositioning it or placing it in a new parent

tools.name: create_component
tools.description: Convert an existing FRAME node into a reusable COMPONENT

tools.name: create_connector
tools.description: Create a connector on the current FigJam page, optionally linked between two nodes

tools.name: create_effect_style
tools.description: Create a new local effect style (drop shadow, inner shadow, or blur)

tools.name: create_ellipse
tools.description: Create a new ellipse (circle/oval) on the current page or inside a parent node

tools.name: create_frame
tools.description: Create a new frame on the current page or inside a parent node

tools.name: create_grid_style
tools.description: Create a new local layout grid style

tools.name: create_paint_style
tools.description: Create a new local paint style with a solid fill color (hex, rgb(), hsl(), or oklch())

tools.name: create_rectangle
tools.description: Create a new rectangle on the current page or inside a parent node

tools.name: create_section
tools.description: Create a Figma Section node on the current page

tools.name: create_sticky
tools.description: Create a sticky note on the current FigJam page

tools.name: create_text
tools.description: Create a new text node on the current page or inside a parent node

tools.name: create_text_style
tools.description: Create a new local text style (typography preset)

tools.name: create_variable
tools.description: Create a new variable (design token) inside an existing collection

tools.name: create_variable_collection
tools.description: Create a new local variable collection with an optional initial mode name

tools.name: delete_nodes
tools.description: Delete one or more nodes

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page from the Figma document

tools.name: delete_style
tools.description: Delete a style (paint, text, effect, or grid) by its ID

tools.name: delete_variable
tools.description: Delete a single variable (variableId), an entire collection (collectionId), or one mode (collectionId + modeId)

tools.name: detach_instance
tools.description: Detach one or more component instances, converting them to plain frames

tools.name: export_frames_to_pdf
tools.description: Export multiple frames as a single multi-page PDF file

tools.name: export_tokens
tools.description: Export all design tokens (variables and paint styles) as JSON or CSS custom properties, in hex, rgb, hsl, or oklch

tools.name: find_replace_text
tools.description: Find and replace text content across all TEXT nodes in a subtree

tools.name: get_annotations
tools.description: Get dev-mode annotations in the current document or scoped to a specific node

tools.name: get_design_context
tools.description: Get a depth-limited, token-efficient tree of the current selection or page

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get the full node tree of the current page (not the whole file — only the active page)

tools.name: get_fonts
tools.description: List all fonts used in the current page, sorted by usage frequency

tools.name: get_local_components
tools.description: Get all components defined in the current Figma file

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata about the current Figma document: file name, pages, current page

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Get a single node by ID with full detail

tools.name: get_nodes_info
tools.description: Get full details for multiple nodes by ID in one round-trip

tools.name: get_pages
tools.description: List all pages in the document with their IDs and names

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: Get the prototype reactions defined on a node

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Export a screenshot of one or more nodes as base64-encoded image data (held in memory)

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get the nodes currently selected in Figma

tools.name: get_styles
tools.description: Get all local styles in the document (paint, text, effect, and grid), including descriptions, publish state, bound variables, and colors in hex, rgb, hsl, or oklch

tools.name: get_variable_defs
tools.description: Get all local variable definitions: collections, modes, and values

tools.name: get_viewport
tools.description: Get the current Figma viewport: scroll center, zoom level, and visible bounds

tools.name: group_nodes
tools.description: Group two or more nodes into a GROUP

tools.name: import_image
tools.description: Import a base64-encoded image into Figma as a rectangle with an image fill

tools.name: lock_nodes
tools.description: Lock one or more nodes to prevent accidental edits in Figma

tools.name: move_nodes
tools.description: Move one or more nodes to an absolute canvas position

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Switch the active Figma page

tools.name: remove_reactions
tools.description: Remove prototype reactions from a node

tools.name: rename_node
tools.description: Rename a single node by ID

tools.name: rename_page
tools.description: Rename an existing page in the Figma document

tools.name: reorder_nodes
tools.description: Change the z-order (layer stack position) of one or more nodes

tools.name: reparent_nodes
tools.description: Move one or more nodes to a different parent frame, group, or section

tools.name: resize_nodes
tools.description: Resize one or more nodes

tools.name: rotate_nodes
tools.description: Rotate one or more nodes to an absolute angle in degrees

tools.name: save_screenshots
tools.description: Export screenshots for multiple nodes and write them to the local filesystem

tools.name: scan_nodes_by_types
tools.description: Find all nodes of specific types in a subtree, regardless of name

tools.name: scan_text_nodes
tools.description: Scan all TEXT nodes in a subtree and return their content

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search for nodes by name substring and/or type within a subtree

tools.name: set_auto_layout
tools.description: Set auto-layout properties on one or more nodes. Container properties (layoutMode, padding, itemSpacing, alignment, wrap) apply to frames, components and instances. Sizing properties apply to the node itself: layoutSizingHorizontal/Vertical HUG needs the node to be an auto-layout frame or text, FILL needs the node to already sit inside an auto-layout parent, and layoutPositioning ABSOLUTE lifts a child out of the parent's flow. Figma only.

tools.name: set_blend_mode
tools.description: Set the blend mode of one or more nodes (e.g

tools.name: set_constraints
tools.description: Set layout constraints (pinning behaviour) on one or more nodes relative to their parent

tools.name: set_corner_radius
tools.description: Set corner radius on one or more nodes

tools.name: set_effects
tools.description: Apply one or more effects (drop shadow, inner shadow, layer blur, background blur) directly to a node

tools.name: set_fills
tools.description: Set the fill color on a single node (takes one nodeId, not an array)

tools.name: set_opacity
tools.description: Set the opacity of one or more nodes (0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque)

tools.name: set_strokes
tools.description: Set the stroke color and weight on a single node (takes one nodeId, not an array)

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Update the text content of an existing TEXT node

tools.name: set_variable_mode
tools.description: Switch which mode of a variable collection applies to a node or the current page — Light/Dark theming preview

tools.name: set_variable_value
tools.description: Set a variable's value for a specific mode, either a literal (hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch()) or an alias to another variable

tools.name: set_visible
tools.description: Show or hide one or more nodes by setting their visibility

tools.name: swap_component
tools.description: Swap the main component of an existing INSTANCE node, replacing it with a different component while keeping position and size

tools.name: ungroup_nodes
tools.description: Ungroup one or more GROUP nodes, moving their children to the parent and removing the group

tools.name: unlock_nodes
tools.description: Unlock one or more nodes, allowing them to be edited again

tools.name: update_style
tools.description: Update an existing style in place: paint color, text font/size/line height, effect array, or grid pattern — plus name and description for any style type

tools.name: update_variable
tools.description: Update a variable's name, description, scopes, or Dev Mode code syntax, or rename a collection or one of its modes
